definitions.atr_14h: True Range (max(high-low, |high-prev_close|, |low-prev_close|)) ewm(span=14, min_periods=14, adjust=False).mean(); identical to VolRegimeFilter._compute_atr / VolBreakoutStrategy._compute_atr
definitions.atr_14h_rolling_percentile_rank_100h: _rolling_last_pct_rank(atr_14h, window=100, min_periods=14) from src.strategies.vol_breakout; causal rolling percentile rank in [0,100] of the last value in each trailing 100-bar window
definitions.eligibility_rule: ELIGIBLE iff rank is finite (notna) AND rank > 25.0 AND rank < 75.0 (STRICT / exclusive bounds); otherwise STAND_ASIDE. First min_bars=30 bars are always STAND_ASIDE regardless of rank.

distinction_from_vol_regime_filter_gener: VolRegimeFilter.generate_signals uses inclusive >= / <= bounds; this eligibility rule uses STRICT (exclusive) > / < bounds instead.
